description: The 18 Nov veterans-association report conditionally threatened a larger early-December protest if the requested law changes did not occur. November searches and the separate 2 Dec search result concern a different demand and organizer; no evidence found here links any December event to this veterans campaign. The threatened action remains unconfirmed.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous reporting from the association or local outlets on an early-December veterans-law protest and any ministry response; do not treat a different December gathering as the promised continuation.
